snippet.title: NashBored Official Trailer (2019)
snippet.description:
A new game from Fading Club!

Available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1003600/NashBored/

NashBored is a surreal Classic RPG with a creepy vibe. Lead Nash through the bizarre landscape of the brain, and get closer to discovering the terrible truth of this world!

Follow Fading Club!
https://twitter.com/FadingClubGames
http://fadingclubgames.tumblr.com/
